selection_reason: MosaicKV targets long-context LLM inference serving by compressing both the sequence and channel dimensions of the KV cache throughout decode. Its per-vector element selection and segment-specific compression strategies address the accuracy loss from uniform two-dimensional compression, while packed sparse attention and asynchronous CPU/GPU cache management translate compression into serving gains. This is directly in scope for LLM inference and KV-cache optimization.
title: MosaicKV: Serving Long-Context LLM with Dynamic Two-D KV Cache Compression
